scope: Read-only source/split provenance review; no execution, data preparation, encryption, fit or scoring. Interval inclusion is record audit, not a new experiment.

findings.original_claim: 数据：仓库既有英文Alice与拉丁Caesar源及原规范化（NFKD/ascii小写，[a-z]+；XML排除note/head/speaker）。训练各前8000完整词，测试每种语言[12000,12080)、[16000,16080)，共4段，每段80词。训练区间、旧开发/测试区间不与这些新测试区间重叠；同书仍非跨作者证据。训练输出词模型按20词块加<s><s>和<\s><\s>；解码每20词一行以预先限制原Viterbi乘积数值风险，保留全部失败。原自然句界不保留，需作为限制。
findings.issue: Broad old-development/test non-overlap language omits the earlier same-scale positive controls. All four proposed windows have been used in those controls.
findings.required_scope: Only disjoint from the old72-search small dev/test windows; all four overlap prior scale calibration. Preserve fixed windows; disclose prior exposure rather than selecting new favorable data.

findings.claim: Source-byte hashes match previously frozen Alice/Caesar sources; normalization steps in the new adapter correspond to old plain_words, including Gutenberg bounds, Alice start marker, XML removals, NFKD/ascii/lowercase and a-z tokenization.
findings.limit: No independent rerun comparing normalized token arrays was performed by this reviewer.

findings.claim: Current train[0,8000) does not overlap new test[12000,12080) or[16000,16080).
findings.limit: This is within-current-experiment separation, not historical non-exposure or cross-book generalization.

findings.claim: Adapter and protocol identify model preparation, fixed smoothing,20-word blocks, wrappers and scoring as ours; author core commit is separately fixed.
findings.limit: Any execution correctness or original-code invariance must be established by the separate execution/implementation audit.

findings.claim: The genuinely new part is the acquired author core, including context-aware Viterbi anagram decoding, rather than another independent4gram key search or most-frequent bag lookup.
findings.limit: New-source calibration is not original-paper dataset/parameter/performance replication.

safe_public_source_scope: 本轮真正新增的是取得固定版本的作者语言识别、MASPA替换和Viterbi重排核心代码，并用我们单独编写的训练/调用适配器校准。训练材料仍为旧项目的Alice与Caesar；四个80词评价片段全部曾用于旧规模正控，只有相对本轮前8000词训练区间的隔离，不能称新的盲集或独立复现。新插值、20词分块、两语言范围和预处理均明确属于本轮配置，不是原论文380语言/50测试案例或93.8%成绩复现；未触及手稿译文。
reviewer_exposure: Same informed AI; read old saved reports and code. All source corpora and old calibration work already exposed. Not an independent expert or blinded assessment.
